name: 内置容器
description: 宿主原生的中栏面板容器（入驻 panel-container 区域）：顶部为多标签栏（Chrome 风格），每个面板插件各驻留一个独立 iframe，切换仅显隐、不重载；容器外壳的结构与样式由本插件提供。
description-en: Native middle-column panel container living in the panel-container area: a Chrome-style tab strip where every panel-area plugin keeps its own persistent iframe (show/hide only, never reloaded). The shell markup and styling are provided by this plugin.
